channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-adsb
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: blindp3w/readsbstats — via awesome-adsb
item.description: Self-hosted flight history and statistics web UI for readsb. Stores positions in SQLite with per-flight track maps, a flagged aircraft gallery, a watchlist, a Telegram bot and receiver metrics.

item.title: Overhead 1090 — via awesome-adsb
item.description: Native iPhone, iPad and Apple TV client for PiAware/dump1090-compatible receivers with a live radar map, logbook, daily reports and notable-sighting alerts. Local-network only, paid app.

item.title: AndrewCTF/velocity — via awesome-adsb
item.description: A self-hosted flight and ship tracker on a 3D globe that records every position it sees so you can replay any moment, and folds in your own receiver's tar1090 or readsb feed.
